name: gravibloc-android
description: Google Play build of Gravibloc (Capacitor wrapper around the HTML5 game)

scripts.web: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp ../game.js ../ads.js www/ && sed -e 's/data-portal="none"/data-portal="admob"/' ../index.html > www/index.html
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync android
